q1.prompt: You must merge overlapping meeting ranges. How do you start?

choices.label: Sort by start, then merge when the next start ≤ current end
Sort by end and greedily keep maximum non-overlapping count

wrong_finish.prompt: Finish-time greedy answers a different ask.
wrong_finish.explanation: Merging overlaps sorts by start and extends the current end. Sorting by end is for selecting a maximum non-overlapping subset.

q2.prompt: Which interval mistake changes the algorithm you need?

choices.label: Do not process intervals unsorted; do not merge when the ask is max non-overlapping count
One sort order solves every interval problem

wrong_refuse.explanation: Do not process intervals unsorted. Do not merge when the ask is maximum non-overlapping count (that wants finish-time greedy). Do not assume closed versus half-open endpoints without checking.

success.prompt: You sorted by start to merge and avoided the wrong interval recipe.
